class.name: OcgGraphic3dTexturemap
class.brief_description: This is an abstract class for managing texture applicable on polygons.
class.description: ! This is an abstract class for managing texture applicable on polygons.

method.name: IsSmoothed
method.description: Returns TRUE if the texture is smoothed.

method.name: EnableModulate
method.description: enable texture modulate mode. the image is modulate with the shading of the surface.

method.name: DisableModulate
method.description: disable texture modulate mode. the image is directly decal on the surface.

method.name: IsModulate
method.description: Returns TRUE if the texture is modulate.

method.name: EnableRepeat
method.description: use this methods if you want to enable texture repetition on your objects.

method.name: DisableRepeat
method.description: use this methods if you want to disable texture repetition on your objects.

method.name: IsRepeat
method.description: Returns TRUE if the texture repeat is enable.

method.name: AnisoFilter
method.description: Returns level of anisotropy texture filter. Default value is Graphic3d_LOTA_OFF.

method.name: SetAnisoFilter
method.description: ! @param theLevel level of anisotropy texture filter.
